svg.title: Allocate $10,000–$60,000 Before Expanding Commitments
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate $10,000–$60,000 Before Expanding Commitments; subtitle: Four buckets illustrate a $30,000 working launch budget.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values show the $30,000 reference allocation in USD. Each stage also gives low-capital and upper-capital allocations; the three complete budgets total $10,000, $30,000, and $60,000. These are capital envelopes, not annual expense forecasts.; caption: Low budget: $4,000 + $2,500 + $2,000 + $1,500 = $10,000. Reference budget: $12,000 + $8,000 + $6,000 + $4,000 = $30,000. Upper budget: $24,000 + $16,000 + $12,000 + $8,000 = $60,000. Customer prepaid balances remain service obligations, not free capital.; stages: label: Supplier deposits and first capacity; value: $12,000 reference allocation for bounded upstream supply access; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Allocate $4,000 at the low budget and $24,000 at the upper budget. Favor cancellable pilot capacity; record refundable deposits separately from consumed services and do not treat the deposit as recurring profit expense.; label: Settlement and loss reserve; value: $8,000 reference allocation for timing gaps and service losses; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Allocate $2,500 at the low budget and $16,000 at the upper budget. Cover supplier settlement timing, refunds, and chargeback exposure with operator cash rather than assuming card-funded wallets cannot reverse.; label: Metering and tenant controls; value: $6,000 reference allocation for instrumentation and containment work; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Allocate $2,000 at the low budget and $12,000 at the upper budget. Implement wallet reconciliation, scoped credentials, routing limits, workload isolation tests, and retention verification before raising usage ceilings.; label: Onboarding and operating setup; value: $4,000 reference allocation for qualified pilots and service setup; numeric value: 4000.0; detail: Allocate $1,500 at the low budget and $8,000 at the upper budget. Fund supplier diligence, applicable registrations, contract review, and narrowly targeted pilot acquisition. Release spending against completed operating evidence.

rect.title: label: Supplier deposits and first capacity; numeric value: 12000.0; value: $12,000 reference allocation for bounded upstream supply access; detail: Allocate $4,000 at the low budget and $24,000 at the upper budget. Favor cancellable pilot capacity; record refundable deposits separately from consumed services and do not treat the deposit as recurring profit expense.

text.title: Supplier deposits and first capacity: $12,000 reference allocation for bounded upstream supply access
text.tspan: Supplier deposits and first capacity: $12,000 reference allocation for bounded upstream supply access

rect.title: label: Settlement and loss reserve; numeric value: 8000.0; value: $8,000 reference allocation for timing gaps and service losses; detail: Allocate $2,500 at the low budget and $16,000 at the upper budget. Cover supplier settlement timing, refunds, and chargeback exposure with operator cash rather than assuming card-funded wallets cannot reverse.

text.title: Settlement and loss reserve: $8,000 reference allocation for timing gaps and service losses
text.tspan: Settlement and loss reserve: $8,000 reference allocation for timing gaps and service losses

rect.title: label: Metering and tenant controls; numeric value: 6000.0; value: $6,000 reference allocation for instrumentation and containment work; detail: Allocate $2,000 at the low budget and $12,000 at the upper budget. Implement wallet reconciliation, scoped credentials, routing limits, workload isolation tests, and retention verification before raising usage ceilings.

text.title: Metering and tenant controls: $6,000 reference allocation for instrumentation and containment work
text.tspan: Metering and tenant controls: $6,000 reference allocation for instrumentation and containment work

rect.title: label: Onboarding and operating setup; numeric value: 4000.0; value: $4,000 reference allocation for qualified pilots and service setup; detail: Allocate $1,500 at the low budget and $8,000 at the upper budget. Fund supplier diligence, applicable registrations, contract review, and narrowly targeted pilot acquisition. Release spending against completed operating evidence.
